zh.text: 评论区不再出现「演练残留」的假评论：本地缓存以前只做过期判断、**不验签**，一份用别的钥匙签出来的快照（本地演练源 / 自建源）一旦写进 `_launcher/cache/mod-reviews/`，就会在某个模组的实时分片取不到时被当成「旧数据」端出去 —— 界面上于是出现几条根本不存在的评论，点回复还会被服务端回一句「reviewId 不合法」（2026-10-02 报障）。现在缓存与网络共用同一个验签函数，验不过**当场删掉**、重新去取真数据。同一个洞在模组市场索引缓存里也补上了，那份更要紧：未验签的索引会把索引里登记的作者公钥注入信任表，等于让本地一份被改过的缓存替所有模组背书。
评论署名不再一律显示「来自未知地区的玩家」：`/v1/reviews/<modId>.json` 分片的 SQL 漏了 `country` 这一列，拼分片时读到的永远是 undefined，所以**任何人**写的评论都落到「未知地区」—— 跟代理开关、跟 IP 都没有关系（2026-10-02 报障）。补上这一列后，正常情况显示「来自中国 / 美国 … 的玩家」加对应旗子。
没有评价的模组不再「取不到评论」：以前 KV 里没有这个模组的分片就回 503，启动器把它当失败，于是回退到本地旧缓存（这正是上面那份假评论被端出来的直接原因）。现在改为回一份**签名过的空分片**（200，`reviews: []`），界面正常显示「还没有人写评价」，也不会再去翻缓存。
回复失败的提示变得能照着做：本地的评论编号校验与服务端 `REVIEW_ID_RE` 对齐（首字符是字母或数字、总长 8–64），编号不对时直接提示「刷新一次模组市场再试」，而不是等服务端回一句看不懂的「reviewId 不合法」。
撤回评论时顺带删掉挂在它上面的作者回复：以前只删评论那一行，回复成了孤儿记录 —— 既不显示、也撤不掉，还一直占着回复计数。

「撤回 / 隐藏」之后旧评论不再残留：分片存在 KV 里、写完或 cron 时才重算，而重算以前**只写不删** —— 一个模组的最后一条评价被删掉之后，它那份旧分片会一直躺在 KV 里被端出去，界面显示的就是「评论明明删了还在」（2026-10-02 报障，实测那种已删除的评价确实还在）。现在每一轮重算都按前缀列一遍分片、只保留这一轮真正有内容的那些（分片是派生物，删了随时能重建），作业日志里同时多一个 `removed` 计数，便于核对「删评论之后分片有没有跟着消失」。

en.text: The review list no longer shows leftover rehearsal comments: the local cache only checked freshness and never verified the signature, so a snapshot signed by some other key (a local rehearsal source or a self-hosted mirror) that once landed in _launcher/cache/mod-reviews/ was served as "old data" whenever a mod's live shard was unavailable — which put a handful of reviews that do not exist on screen, and replying to them came back "reviewId 不合法" (reported 2026-10-02). The cache now goes through the exact same verifier as the network path: a payload that fails verification is deleted on the spot and the real data is fetched instead. The same hole is fixed in the mod-index cache, where it mattered more: an unverified index feeds its author public keys into the trust table, so one edited local file could vouch for every mod.

Review bylines no longer always read "Player from an unknown region": the shard SQL behind /v1/reviews/<modId>.json never selected the country column, so the value was always undefined and every review landed in "unknown" — nothing to do with a proxy or the caller's IP (reported 2026-10-02). With the column selected, reviews now read "Player from China / the United States / …" with the matching flag.

Mods with no reviews no longer fail to load: a mod without a shard in KV used to answer 503, which the launcher treated as a failure and fell back to the stale local cache (the direct reason the fake comments above surfaced). It now answers with a signed empty shard (200, reviews: []), so the UI shows the normal "no reviews yet" state and never touches the cache.

Reply failures now come with something you can act on: the local review-id check mirrors the service's REVIEW_ID_RE (first character alphanumeric, 8–64 characters total), so a malformed id is rejected up front with "refresh the mod market and try again" instead of waiting for the opaque "reviewId 不合法" from the service.

Retracting a review now also deletes the author replies attached to it: previously only the review row was removed and the replies became orphans — invisible, impossible to retract, and still counted.

Retracted or hidden reviews no longer linger: shards live in KV and are recomputed on write or by the cron, and that recomputation used to write without ever deleting — once a mod's last review was removed, its old shard stayed in KV and kept being served, so the UI showed a review that no longer existed (reported 2026-10-02 and reproduced live). Every rebuild now lists the shard keys and keeps only those with content in that round (shards are derived data and can always be rebuilt), and the job log reports a removed count so it is easy to confirm that deleting a review also drops its shard.
